description: Lean verifyScriptFull finalLen does not model Core's stack.resize(1) for the P2SH-wrapped witness arm, so a valid P2SH-wrapped witness spend is rejected with CLEANSTACK when pol.cleanstack = true.

p2sh-p2wsh.role: divergent witness (minimal witness data: one 1-byte item)

bare-p2wpkh.role: control: the bare arm the Lean model does resize

p2sh-plain.role: control: non-witness P2SH; the finalLen re-evaluation agrees with Core

checker: Bitcoin.Crypto.Seam.stubChecker (Lean) / AcceptAllChecker (Core); the finding is independent of signature validity
note: CLEANSTACK is policy-only (rules.yaml SCR-008 consensus: false); the divergence is a false rejection at the policy face, not a consensus split.
